title: Stale/zero-TVL share mispricing lets a depositor steal existing holders' PnL
root_cause: _convertToShares falls back to the first-deposit 1e12-offset rate whenever _totalValueLocked() reads 0 even when totalSupply>0; _totalValueLocked=idle+gmValueInUsdc and gmValueInUsdc returns 0 when the 0xM market token price is <=0, so idle<=~0 + gmPrice<=0 with real GM value => TVL reads 0 => permissionless depositAndLock mints at the stale rate and dilutes existing holders.
attacker_capabilities: deposit USDC permissionlessly while the 0xM GM price reads <=0 and child idle is deployed

severity_justification.worst_case: Permissionless theft of existing holders' accrued PnL during a zero-TVL read.
severity_justification.realistic_case: CONFIRMED reachable (0xM getMarketTokenPrice returns <=0 when poolValue<=0, a real market state; Cartha minimize=false makes it more likely); needs the child's idle ~fully deployed (idle~0) at the read.
severity_justification.program_table_mapping: see official program impact table (not bundled)

bounty_program_mapping.scope_reference: Cartha contest (cartha-vaults-main @ 4c51f2a); official scope list not bundled with PoC package.

call_trace: victim deposits 100k; keeper deploys to 0xM (idle->0); GM grows to 150k
attacker depositAndLock(100k) mints at 1e12 first-deposit rate (not live price)
GM price recovers => TVL 250k; attacker claims 125k for 100k; victim 150k->125k

state_transition.before: victim alone worth 150k (GM value, idle drained)

asset_delta: Attacker claims 125k for a 100k deposit; victim 150k->125k => 25k of existing holders' PnL stolen.
false_positive_risks: CONFIRMED reachable (0xM getMarketTokenPrice returns <=0 when poolValue<=0, a real market state; Cartha minimize=false makes it more likely); needs the child's idle ~fully deployed (idle~0) at the read.
invalidating_conditions: only if the child's idle USDC is NOT meaningfully deployed (idle large) so TVL never reads 0

defense_analysis.why_it_fails: blunts donation rounding-to-zero, but the TVL==0 first-deposit fallback is the bug here
dilution is locked in at mint time; attacker realizes it after the lock expires
0xMarkets getMarketTokenPrice is signed int256 and returns 0/negative by design when poolValue<=0 (confirmed in 0xM source) -> gmValueInUsdc returns 0 -> TVL==0

assumptions: perp deployment with 0xM pool wired (reader/oracle set)
evidence_links: CONFIRMED reachable: 0xMarkets MarketUtils.getMarketTokenPrice returns 0 when poolValue==0 and negative when poolValue<0 (int256 poolValue = pool USD - capped pending trader PnL); Cartha uses maximize=false (minimize) which makes <=0 more likely
triager_summary: Stale/zero-TVL share mispricing lets a depositor steal existing holders' PnL — PASS: attacker deposits 100k at stale rate -> claims 125k; victim 150k->125k (25k stolen)
vrt_category: Business Logic Errors (ERC-4626 share mispricing: `_convertToShares` falls back to the first-deposit 1e12 rate when `_totalValueLocked()` reads 0 while `totalSupply>0` and value exists → deposit at a stale rate steals existing holders' value)  ·  Blockchain → Transaction-Ordering Dependence (TOD) / Front Running (JIT deposit timed to the zero-TVL window)
